## Activity

During May 2024, River Outreach recorded 72 captures. This is the total activity reported for the site and month. The capture figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. It should be read alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the number identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 72 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.6. This indicates the proportion of reported captures for which grading could not be completed. The ungradable count and rate are included to support routine monitoring of image quality at River Outreach.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results. The median lag was 2. This is the reported median interval associated with grading for the May 2024 activity. Together, the grading result and median lag provide a summary of the reviewed activity for River Outreach. The figures should be retained as the operational record for the period and considered with the activity and image-quality measures above.
